summary_en: 190,000 shares acquired via ToSTNeT-3 from Mitsui Metals; original program planned 290,500 shares but actual acquisition totaled 190,000 shares; transaction completed; amount not disclosed; shares outstanding (ex-treasury) 24,446 units.
title_en: (CORRECTED) Notice of Partial Correction Regarding Execution of Capital and Business Alliance Agreement with Heulic Co., Ltd., Termination of Capital and Technology Alliance with Mitsui Metals Co., Ltd., Acquisition of Treasury Stock, and Changes in Major Shareholders and Related Parties
translation_en_brief: This is a corrected notice amending a disclosure filed on 3 August 2026 regarding capital alliance and treasury stock transactions. The company originally announced plans to acquire 290,500 shares held by Mitsui Metals Co., Ltd. via ToSTNeT-3 (off-market trading mechanism). However, the actual acquisition completed was 190,000 shares, not the originally planned 290,500 shares. The correction updates Mitsui Metals' post-transaction voting rights and shareholder ranking accordingly. Following the acquisition and concurrent transfer of 490,500 shares to Heulic Co., Ltd., Mitsui Metals' voting rights decline from 7,810 units (31.94% of shares outstanding) to 1,005 units (4.11%), reducing its status from major shareholder to fifth-largest shareholder. The shares outstanding (excluding treasury) at 31 March 2026 is 24,446 units. No acquisition price is disclosed in this notice.
